verdict.on_screen_text: a native omni.ui panel — rendered headless on a CPU | built an omni.ui panel 420x360, 7 refs | checked 4 gates, all passed | attacked 11/11 = 100% mutants all failed a gate | the spec → the render the judge graded | widget gate: every ref live, bboxes ±8 px | swatch median is exactly the analytic target | the judge's own self-test, 22.1x speed | judge verdict: PASS 4/4 gates, render byte-identical | python3 cookbook/ovui-native-ui/run.py | Ask your agent to build a native omni.ui panel judged by a harness it cannot fool | headless Vulkan on a real sandbox — CPU-only
verdict.why: The video hooks instantly by opening on the finished render with the PASS verdict already stamped, so a muted viewer sees the payoff at 0 s. The hard-cut black flashes between shots create clear scene boundaries. Captions are large and legible on a phone screen. The terminal replay of the self-test with colour-coded PASS/FAIL lines is a real terminal capture, not a text slide.
fixes: The swatch zoom shot could hold longer to let the median vs target numbers settle.
The sandbox segment's terminal log wraps aggressively at high speed; a slightly larger font would improve phone readability.
